cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Could you apologise for judging my cake after everyone knew it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. You introduced it as 'another interesting attempt.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for encouraging the judges before they'd tasted it.

mechanism: A corrects how a presenter describes judging influence to obtain an apology for biasing the comparison before tasting.
confusable: Generic reassurance about losing is not D195; the acknowledgment must name the skewed comparison.
comparison: Public framing of a cake differs from a physical race starting disadvantage.
seedUse: Keep exact interesting-attempt quote and encouragement defense; specify requested acknowledgment.
